source: Illwinter: Dominions 6 Modding Manual (6.33) and Event Modding Manual (6.29); tools/command_hints.py

copyarmor.text: Copies all stats from an existing armor. This command will overwrite all stats for the selected armor, so it should be used as the first command after the #newarmor command.

def.text: Sets the defense bonus. A chain mail cuirass has a defense bonus of -1. For shields, use this command to set parry value. Final parry value is always the #def value minus #enc value.

enc.text: Set the encumbrance value. A chain mail cuirass has an encumbrance of 1. For shields, use this command to set defense penalty (e.g. "#enc 2" means defense -2).

ironarmor.text: Indicates that the armor is made of iron.

magicarmor.text: Indicates that the armor is magic. Magic armors are more resistant to being destroyed by magic effects.

name.text: This must be the first command for every new armor. It sets the name of the armor.

newarmor.text: Armor nbr should be a number between 300 and 999. It must not be the same as any other armor. This new armor will be affected by the following modding commands and there should be an #end command at the end.

prot.text: Sets the protection value of the armor. A chain mail cuirass has a protection value of 9.

protparts.text: Sets the protection value of an armor that has both head and body protecion, e.g. a horse barding that includes head protection.

rcost.text: Sets the resource cost for the armor.

selectarmor.text: Selects the armor that will be affected by the following modding commands. End modding this armor with the #end command. To find out what the number of a particular unit’s armor, look at the unit’s stats in the game and press ctrl+i.

woodenarmor.text: Indicates that the armor is made of wood.

chaosscale.text: The bless requires a chaos scale of value or more.

clearfx.text: Clear all effects of this bless.

coldscale.text: The bless requires a cold scale of value or more.

cost0.text: The minimum skill required in path0 and also the cost in bless points.

cost1.text: The minimum skill required in path1 and also added to the cost in bless points.

deathscale.text: The bless requires a death scale of value or more.

drainscale.text: The bless requires a drain scale of value or more.

end.text: Always use this command at the end of modifying a blessing.

growthscale.text: The bless requires a growth scale of value or more.

heatscale.text: The bless requires a heat scale of value or more.

luckscale.text: The bless requires a luck scale of value or more.

magicscale.text: The bless requires a magic scale of value or more.

misfortscale.text: The bless requires a misfortune scale of value or more.

name.text: Sets the name for the active blessing. Changing name of a blessing will also remove its description.

orderscale.text: The bless requires an order scale of value or more.

path0.text: The path (0-8) required to choose this blessing.

path1.text: An optional secondary path requirement. Use -1 to clear this.

prodscale.text: The bless requires a production scale of value or more.

selectbless.text: Selects an existing blessing that will be affected by the following modding commands. End modding this blessing with the #end command.

slothscale.text: The bless requires a sloth scale of value or more.

10d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 10d6 units.

11d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 11d6 units.

12d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 12d6 units.

13d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 13d6 units.

14d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 14d6 units.

15d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 15d6 units.

16d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 16d6 units.

1d3units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 1d3 units.

1d3vis.text: Gain 1d3 gems of specified type. Event will not occur if income cannot be trace to a friendly lab.

1d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 1d6 units.

1d6vis.text: Gain 1d6 gems of specified type. Event will not occur if income cannot be trace to a friendly lab.

1unit.text: The nation that owns the event gains one unit.

2com.text: The nation that owns the event gains two commanders of the specified type.

2d3units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 2d3 units.

2d4vis.text: Gain 2d4 gems of specified type. Event will not occur if income cannot be trace to a friendly lab.

2d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 2d6 units.

2d6vis.text: Gain 2d6 gems of specified type. Event will not occur if income cannot be trace to a friendly lab.

3d3units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 3d3 units.

3d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 3d6 units.

3d6vis.text: Gain 3d6 gems of specified type. Event will not occur if income cannot be trace to a friendly lab.

4com.text: The nation that owns the event gains four commanders of the specified type.

4d3units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 4d3 units.

4d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 4d6 units.

4d6vis.text: Gain 4d6 gems of specified type. Event will not occur if income cannot be trace to a friendly lab.

5com.text: The nation that owns the event gains five commanders of the specified type.

5d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 5d6 units.

6d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 6d6 units.

7d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 7d6 units.

8d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 8d6 units.

9d6units.text: The nation that owns the event gains 9d6 units.

addascension.text: Adds to the number of ascension points required to win the game. This command has no effect if the thrones win condition is not in effect. AP can be negative to make ascension easier.

addequip.text: Adds magic items to a commander. Equipment level is from 1 to 4 and corresponds to item level from trinkets to very powerful items. Use the value 9 for equipment level and a bracketed "item name" in the #msg text to add a specific magic item. An item is not guaranteed at equipment level 1. The command also gives the commander gems appropriate to his magic paths.

addgeo.text: Adds to the terrains in the province. A number of 128 would add the forest terrain to the province.

addkills.text: One commander determined by target requirements will get this number added to the number of kills he has. The resulting value will never go below zero.

addseductions.text: One commander determined by target requirements will get this number added to the number of seductions she has successfully performed. The resulting value will never go below zero.

addsite.text: Adds a new, already discovered site to the province. Use -1 for site number to place "sitename" instead. "sitename" must be added to event message text in brackets.

airboost.text: One commander determined by target requirements or the monster number may gain +1 Air magic.

arena.text: Opens the Area Death Match for competitors. Players will be able to send heroes to the arena this turn.

assassin.text: An assassin of this type attacks a random commander in the province. If a target requirement for the event is set, the assassin attacks that commander.

assfollower1.text: Assassins from following event commands will receive 1 follower of this type.

assfollower1d3.text: Assassins from following event commands will receive 1d3 followers of this type.

assfollower2.text: Assassins from following event commands will receive 2 followers of this type.

assfollower3.text: Assassins from following event commands will receive 3 followers of this type.

assowner.text: The following assassins created by this event will be owned by this nation.

assownerench.text: The following assassins created by this event will be owned by the owner of this enchantment.

astralboost.text: One commander determined by target requirements or the monster number may gain +1 Astral magic.

banished.text: One commander determined by target requirements is banished to another plane. -11 = The Void, -12 = Inferno, -13 = Kokytos.

bloodboost.text: One commander determined by target requirements or the monster number may gain +1 Blood magic.

claimthrone.text: Any throne in the province is claimed by the event owner.

clear.text: Use this if you want to remove everything from the event.

clearallevents.text: This command removes all events from the game. You usually don't want to use this command.

cleartarg.text: Commander set by target requirements is cleared. Commands after this will use default target.

clearvar.text: Sets an event var (0 to 9999) to zero.

code.text: Sets the event code of the current province (when planned for globals)

code2.text: Sets the eventcode of the current province (when executed for globals)

codedelay.text: Sets the event code of the current province, but not immediately. It will be set after all events have been executed this turn.

codedelay2.text: Sets the event code of the current province, but not immediately. It will be set after all events have been executed on the next turn.

com.text: The nation that owns the event gains a commander of the specified type.

curse.text: Every unit in the province has this chance of being cursed.

deathboost.text: One commander determined by target requirements or the monster number may gain +1 Death magic.

dec10var.text: Decreases ten from an event var.

decscale.text: Decreases the specified scale in the province by one step.

decscale2.text: Decreases the specified scale in the province by two steps.

decscale3.text: Decreases the specified scale in the province by three steps.

decvar.text: Decreases one from an event var.

delay.text: Succeeding event occurs <value> turns after this event. The succeeding event will not occur normally.

delay25.text: Succeeding event occurs <value> +/-25% turns after this event. The succeeding event will not occur normally.

delay50.text: Succeeding event occurs <value> +/-50% turns after this event. The succeeding event will not occur normally.

delayskip.text: Use this command right after a delay command. This is the chance that the next next event will be used instead of the next one, when determining what delayed event to execute. The next next event will not occur normally.

disease.text: Every unit in the province has this chance of becoming diseased.

dispglobals.text: Reduces strength of all global enchantment with a random number d(str). If it is reduced to zero the enchantment will be dispelled.

earthboost.text: One commander determined by target requirements or the monster number may gain +1 Earth magic.

emigration.text: A percentage of the province population emigrates elsewhere.

end.text: Always use this command at the end of modifying an event.

exactgold.text: The nation that owns the event gains <value> gold. Use negative numbers for gold loss.

extramsg.text: This nation will also get the event message.

fireboost.text: One commander determined by target requirements or the monster number may gain +1 Fire magic.

flagland.text: Sets or removes an event flag from a province. The event flag is displayed as an image of a book on the map. 1 = set flag, 0 = remove flag. Requires an event code in the province. If the event code is reset to 0, the flag automatically disappears.

force1d3vis.text: Gain 1d3 gems of specified type. Event may occur even if income cannot be traced to a friendly lab.

force1d6vis.text: Gain 1d6 gems of specified type. Event may occur even if income cannot be traced to a friendly lab.

force2d4vis.text: Gain 2d4 gems of specified type. Event may occur even if income cannot be traced to a friendly lab.

force2d6vis.text: Gain 2d6 gems of specified type. Event may occur even if income cannot be traced to a friendly lab.

force3d6vis.text: Gain 3d6 gems of specified type. Event may occur even if income cannot be traced to a friendly lab.

force4d6vis.text: Gain 4d6 gems of specified type. Event may occur even if income cannot be traced to a friendly lab.

forceexactgold.text: The nation that owns the event gains <value> gold. Use negative numbers for gold loss. This event may occur event if income cannot be traced to a friendly fort.

forcegold.text: The nation that owns the event gains <value> gold. Use negative numbers for gold loss. The value varies with +/-50%. This event may occur event if income cannot be traced to a friendly fort.

forcetransform.text: One commander determined by target requirements is transformed into another monster, negative numbers can be used for montags. This command can even transform gods and other units that are immune to polymorph.

fort.text: Builds a fort of the specified type in the province. Use fort number 0 to remove a fort and all ongoing construction progress.

gainaff.text: One commander determined by target requirements gains the specified affliction. Afflictions are listed in the table below. The bitmask is expressed as powers of 2. Add together several bitmasks if more than one affliction is desired.

gainmark.text: One commander determined by target requirements gains one level of horrormark.

gemloss.text: Lose 3d6 gems of specified type. Gem type 53 can be used for all types, then 1d6 will be lost of each type of gem. Use gem type 56 to exclude blood slaves.

glamourboost.text: One commander determined by target requirements or the monster number may gain +1 Glamour magic.

gold.text: The nation that owns the event gains <value> gold. Use negative numbers for gold loss. The value varies with +/-50%.

header.text: Usually all messages start with "An unexpected event has occured in...". Use this command to change that. Type 1 = no unexpected, 2 = no header. If you use 2 (no header) the first line in the message will be used as a header, the header should end with two newlines before the rest of the message.

healaff.text: One commander determined by target requirements gets nbr of affliction healing chances. One healing chance can remove at most a single permanent battle affliction, and sometimes no affliction is healed.

hiddensite.text: Adds a new, hidden site to the province. Use -1 for site number to place "sitename" instead. "sitename" must be added to event message text in brackets.

holyboost.text: One commander determined by target requirements or the monster number may gain +1 Priest level.

id.text: Sets an event identifier. Used for spells that create anonymous random events.

inc10var.text: Adds ten to an event var.

inccorpses.text: Number of unburied corpses increases by this amount +/-25%. The value can be negative to remove corpses.

incdom.text: Increases dominion in the province by <value> candles.

incpop.text: Province population increases by this amount +/-25%.

incscale.text: Increases the specified scale in the province by one step.

incscale2.text: Increases the specified scale in the province by two steps.

incscale3.text: Increases the specified scale in the province by three steps.

incvar.text: Adds one to an event var.

invvar.text: Inverts the value of an event var (result = -event var).

kill.text: Kills off a percentage of the province population.

kill2d6mon.text: Kills 2d6 non-commander units of the specified type in the province.

killcom.text: Kills a commander of the specified type in the province.

killmon.text: Kills one non-commander unit of the specified type in the province.

killpop.text: Kills off a fixed number of province population. One dekapop equals 10 inhabitants. The exact amount varies with +/-25%.

killtarg.text: One commander determined by target requirements is killed. The mount is also killed if any.

lab.text: The event either creates or destroys a lab. 1 = new lab, 0 = lab destroyed.

landgold.text: Permanent increase to province gold income. Can be negative to reduce income.

landprod.text: Permanent increase to province resources. Can be negative to cause reduce resources.

linger.text: Use this command for global events whose effects last for more than one turn.

magicitem.text: The nation that owns the event gains a magic item that is placed directly into the lab. Item rarity is listed in the table below. When rarity 9 is used, add the itemname in brackets at the end of the event message text defined by the #msg command.

maybeaddsite.text: Like addsite, but only add the site if it doesn't already exist.

maybehiddensite.text: Like hiddesite, but only adds a site if it doesn't already exist.

minascension.text: Ensures the number of ascension points required to win the game is at least this many.

msg.args: "An adventurous young mage is searching for the
msg.text: fabled Singing Stones. [Singing Stones]" In this example the event probably contains a requirement for the magic site Singing Stones to be in the province or an adjacent province and the command formulation requires the name of the site to be inserted into the message text of the event. There are also many special tags that can be inserted in the message text to print certain variables, e.g. the name of the land or the name of the player's pretender. See the list below for the possible tags that can be used. ##landname## ##godname## (god name + 1 random title) ##fullgodname## (god name + all titles) ##disname## (use name of disciple if current player is one, otherwise name of god) ##goddisname## (50% chance of using name of disciple if current player is a disciple) ##targname## (name of targeted commander) (not for global events) ##fulltargname## (name + unit type of targeted commander) (not for global events) ##targhis## (his/her depending on targeted commander) (not for global events) ##natname## (name of nation, e.g. Vanheim, Abysia) ##profname## (name of prophet/disciple) The message text can be at most 2399 characters long.

nation.text: Sets the nation that owns the event. The default owner is independents. -1 = random enemy, -2 = province owner. The effects of the event are applied in the province where the event occurs and by the nation who owns the event. In an event with an attack, it can be used to set the attacking troops to be non-independents.

nationench.text: Sets the event owner to the nation that has this global enchantment active. This command is useful to create global enchantments that spawns units owned by the caster of the global enchantment.

natureboost.text: One commander determined by target requirements or the monster number may gain +1 Nature magic.

newdom.text: Changes dominion to that of the event owner and sets it to the level of 1d(value) candles.

newevent.text: This command creates a new event. All subsequent commands will modify this event until modding the event is finished with the #end command.

nolog.text: Event does not appear in the chronicle (event history) of the province where it occurs.

notext.text: Event does not generate a message.

order.text: Set special event orders that are enabled for the province (investigate, accept, decline etc). If several orders are needed to be available, add together all the mask values for the orders. The nil order resets all order options. See table below.

pathboost.text: The mage who gains this event has the specified path level increased by 1, to a maximum of 5. The target of this event is set by the target requirements of the event. Path must be a single magic path, nbr 0 -9.

poison.text: One commander determined by target requirements is poisoned. The poison effect is armor negating but the damage will vary a bit anyway because of the usual +2d6 -2d6 calculations.

purgecalendar.text: Removes an event determined by attr from the global event calendar. 1 = the event that had been added after this event would be affected. 0 = current event -1 = the previous event. The event calendar contains the planned global events that will occur in the coming 7 months.

purgedelayed.text: Removes an event from the delayed event list (same attr as previous command). Delayed events are events added by the #delay command.

rarity.text: Sets the rarity of the event. Normal events should use number 1, 2, -1, -2, 11 or 12. The other numbers are always events that are best used for creating global enchantment effects or special dominion effects. The always events will occur every month in every province unless they are limited somehow. The normal always event uses rarity 0 and only one rarity 0 event can occur in each province per month. Rarity 5 is like rarity 0, except that any number of rarity 5 events can occur in a single province each month. Usually rarity 5 should only be used for global enchantment effects. The global events are planned 7 months before they are executed, except for number 13 that happens immediately. This delay is necessary because fortune tellers should be able to foresee them. Otherwise the events will appear by random chance. Event rarities are listed in the table below. Certain event effects can modify the event calendar.

remgeo.text: Removes from the terrains in the province. A number of 128 would remove the forest terrain should there be any.

remount.text: The commander determined by target requirements regains his mount, should he have lost it.

removesite.text: Removes a site from the province. Use -1 for site number to place "sitename" instead. "sitename" must be added to event message text in brackets. The site will be be removed regardless of being found or not.

req_2monsters.text: This monster must be present in the province and there must be at least 2 of them.

req_5monsters.text: This monster must be present in the province and there must be at least 5 of them.

req_ai.text: The event can only occur for AI players (0=cannot).

req_anycode.text: Event code must be present somewhere in the world. Can be used multiple times for an event. If the command is used multiple times, one of the codes being present is sufficient to fulfill the requirement.

req_arenadone.text: The will require that an arena battle has taken place (been resolved) earlier this turn. If set to zero an arena battle must not have taken place.

req_capital.text: Event can only happen in capital provinces. This includes conquered capital provinces. 1 = only in capitals, 0 = never in capitals

req_cave.text: Event requires the province to have cave terrain. 1 = must be cave, 0 = cannot be cave.

req_claimedthrone.text: The throne "sitename" must be claimed by someone. Combine with #req_site to target the throne province.

req_coast.text: Event requires the province to have coastal terrain. 1 = must be coast, 0 = cannot be coast.

req_code.text: Province must have this event code. Can be used multiple times for an event. If the command is used multiple times, one of the codes being present is sufficient to fulfill the requirement. Use #req_code 0 for events that generate event codes. Otherwise they may break ongoing event chains.

req_commander.text: There must be a non-sneaking commander present for the event to happen. 1 = yes, 0 = no.

req_crystal.text: Event requires the province to have crystal cave terrain.

req_deadmnr.text: This monster must be present or be among the dead monsters or the event cannot happen. Unique monsters and heroes stay among the dead monsters when they are killed, ordinary monsters are purged from memory when they are killed. Use this command to see if a unique monster has ever been summoned to the game.

req_deep.text: Event requires the province to have deep sea (deep sea gorges also ok) terrain.

req_domchance.text: Requires a dominion and the higher dominion the higher the chance of this event happening. The owner of the dominion, friendly or not, does not matter for this command. The event will have dominion value * this value % chance of happening (if it should have happened without this command that is). This command can be used to create global enchantments that have the chance of something happening scale with dominion strength.

req_dominion.text: The province must have the owner's dominion at <value> candles or more.

req_domowner.text: The event requires this nation to have dominion in the province.

req_drip.text: Event requires the province to have drip cave terrain.

req_enchdom.text: This enchantment must be active and in its owner's dominion.

req_enchnearby.text: This global enchantment must be active and have its origin in the current or a neigboring province.

req_enchtarget.text: This global enchantment must be active and have its origin in the current province.

req_era.text: Can only happen in this era. 1 = early, 2 = mid, 3 = late

req_farm.text: Event requires the province to have farm terrain. 1 = must be farm, 0 = cannot be farm.

req_forest.text: Event requires the province to have forest terrain. 1 = must be forest, 0 = cannot be forest.

req_forestcave.text: Event requires the province to have forest cave terrain.

req_fornation.text: The event can only happen for this nation. This command can be used multiple times for the same event to enable it for multiple nations.

req_fort.text: There must be a fort in the province. 1 = yes, 0 = no

req_fortid.text: There must be a fort in the province and it must be of this type.

req_foundsite.text: Event requires "sitename" to be in the province and discovered.

req_freesites.text: The province must have at least <value> free site slots for the event to happen. Remember to use this requirement if the event creates a site.

req_freshwater.text: Event requires the province to have fresh water. 1 = must have fresh water, 0 = cannot have fresh water.

req_friendlyench.text: This enchantment must be active and friendly.

req_fullowner.text: The event requires this nation to control the province, any fort (if present) and to have positive dominion in the province.

req_gem.text: There must be at least one gem of the required type in the gem treasury. Gem types are listed in the table below.

req_godawake.text: 1 = Requires the event owner's Pretender God (or Disiple) to be alive and on the map somewhere.

req_godismnr.text: Requires the event owner's Pretender God (or Disciple) to be a specific monster type. If a pretender can change between different shapes, this command will trigger if it matches anyone of the possible shapes. This command can be used multiple times, in which case only one of the monster types is required.

req_godisnotmnr.text: Requires the event owner's Pretender God (or Disciple) to not be this specific monster type. This command can be used multiple times, in which case the god mustn't be any of these types.

req_gold.text: The nation must have at least this much gold in the treasury.

req_gorge.text: Event requires the province to have gorge sea terrain.

req_hiddensite.text: Event requires "sitename" to be in the province and not discovered.

req_hostileench.text: This enchantment must be active and hostile.

req_humanoidres.text: There must be a humanoid researcher present in the province for the event to happen.

req_indepok.text: Event can also happen to independents. 1 = yes, 0 = no.

req_kelp.text: Event requires the province to have a kelp sea terrain.

req_lab.text: There must be a lab in the province. 1 = yes, 0 = no

req_land.text: Event requires land province. 1 = land, 0 = sea.

req_maxcorpses.text: There mustn't be more than this number of unburied corpses in the province.

req_maxdef.text: There may not be more than <value> PD in the province for the event to happen. The value varies with +/-25%.

req_maxdominion.text: The province must have a dominion strength of no more than <value> for the event to happen. Negative values can be used and mean that enemy dominion of that strength or stronger is required for the event to happen.

req_maxglobals.text: There must be at most this many global enchantments active.

req_maxpop.text: There may not be more than this amount of population in the province. One dekapop = 10 population in game.

req_maxtroops.text: There may not be more than this many troops in the province for the event to happen.

req_maxturn.text: The event cannot happen after this turn.

req_maxunrest.text: There cannot be more than <value> unrest in the province for the event to happen. The value varies with +/-25%.

req_mincorpses.text: There must be at least this number of unburied corpses in the province.

req_mindef.text: There must be at least <value> PD in the province for the event to happen. The value varies with +/-25%.

req_minglobals.text: There must be at least this many global enchantments active.

req_minpop.text: There must be at least this much population in the province.

req_minresearch.text: Requires the player to have researched to at least this level in the active research school.

req_mintroops.text: There must be at least this many troops in the province for the event to happen.

req_minunrest.text: There must be at least <value> unrest in the province for the event to happen. The value varies with +/-25%.

req_mnr.text: This monster must be present somewhere in the world or the event cannot happen. The command can be used multiple times and then all of the monsters must be in the world.

req_monster.text: This monster must be present in the province.

req_month.text: Month of the year required. E.g. 4 = mid summer, 10 = mid winter.

req_mountain.text: Event requires the province to have mountain or border mountain terrain. 1 = must be mountain, 0 = cannot be mountain.

req_mydominion.text: Event requires province owner's dominion. 0 = must not have owner's dominion.

req_myench.text: This enchantment must be active and owned by the event owner.

req_nation.text: This nation must be in play for the event to happen.

req_nativesoil.text: Event must be on land for most nations or underwater if it regards an underwater nation.

req_nearbycapital.text: Event can only happen in capital provinces or provinces next to a capital. This includes conquered capital provinces. 1 = only near capitals, 0 = never near capitals

req_nearbycode.text: Event code must be present in a neighboring province.

req_nearbysite.text: Event requires "sitename" to be in the province or in adjacent provinces.

req_nearbythrone.text: Event requires a throne to be in the province or in adjacent provinces.

req_nearowncode.text: Current province or neighboring province owned by the same player must have this event code.

req_nomnr.text: This monster must not be present in the world or the event cannot happen. This requirement is best used with unique monsters or national heroes. This command can be used multiple times and then none of the monsters may be in the world. For example, #req_nomnr 563 would require the Queen of Storms to not have been summoned yet. If she has already been summoned, the event can no longer happen. If she is killed, the event can happen again until she is summoned once more.

req_nomonster.text: This monster cannot be present in the province.

req_nonation.text: If this nation is in play the event cannot occur.

req_nopathair.text: There cannot be an Air mage of this level or higher in the province.

req_nopathall.text: There cannot be a mage or priest of any kind of this level or higher in the province.

req_nopathastral.text: There cannot be an Astral mage of this level or higher in the province.

req_nopathblood.text: There cannot be a Blood mage of this level or higher in the province.

req_nopathdeath.text: There cannot be a Death mage of this level or higher in the province.

req_nopathearth.text: There cannot be an Earth mage of this level or higher in the province.

req_nopathfire.text: There cannot be a Fire mage of this level or higher in the province.

req_nopathglamour.text: There cannot be a Glamour mage of this level or higher in the province.

req_nopathholy.text: There cannot be a Priest of this level or higher in the province.

req_nopathnature.text: There cannot be a Nature mage of this level or higher in the province.

req_nopathwater.text: There cannot be a Water mage of this level or higher in the province.

req_norealmnr.text: Same as req_nomnr, but no shape changing abilities are taken into account. So a werwolf in its human form will not match with the same werewolf's wolf form using this command.

req_noseason.text: The event cannot happen in this season.

req_nositenbr.text: There cannot be this site in the province. If there is, the event cannot happen. This command only accepts the site number as an attribute.

req_notanycode.text: Event code must not be present in the world. Can be used multiple times for an event. If the command is used multiple times, none of the codes may be present.

req_notcode.text: Province must not have this event code. Can be used multiple times for an event.

req_notforally.text: This nation and its allies cannot receive the event. In a non-disciple game this will have the same effect as req_notfornation.

req_notfornation.text: This nation cannot receive the event. The old variant "req_notnation" can also be used for the same effect.

req_notpoptype.text: The province must not have this poptype.

req_noworlditem.text: This item must not exist anywhere in the world.

req_owncapital.text: Event can only happen in event owner's own capital province. 1 = only in event owner's capital, 0 = never in event owner's capital

req_path.text: Sets the active magic path, this will be useful for the next command.

req_pathair.text: There must be an Air mage of at least this level in the province.

req_pathastral.text: There must be an Astral mage of at least this level in the province.

req_pathblood.text: There must be a Blood mage of at least this level in the province.

req_pathdeath.text: There must be a Death mage of at least this level in the province.

req_pathearth.text: There must be an Earth mage of at least this level in the province.

req_pathfire.text: There must be a Fire mage of at least this level in the province.

req_pathgems.text: There must be at least this amount of gems of the active magic path in the gem treasury.

req_pathglamour.text: There must be a Glamour mage of at least this level in the province.

req_pathholy.text: There must be a Priest of at least this level in the province.

req_pathnature.text: There must be a Nature mage of at least this level in the province.

req_pathwater.text: There must be a Water mage of at least this level in the province.

req_permonth.text: This event can only happen <nbr> times per month.

req_plane.text: Event can only occur on this plane. 0 = default plane (demiurgia), 1+ = other map planes, -1 = cave plane, -2 = nexus plane. If no custom map with extra planes is used, 1 will be the same as the cave plane and 2 will be the same as the nexus plane. Setting req_plane -2 will also enable the event to occur on that plane (no req_voidok necessary).

req_pop0ok.text: The event can also happen in provinces with no population. Standard events are limited to provinces with at least 50 population (5 dekapop).

req_poptype.text: The province must have the correct poptype.

req_preach.text: Event has a chance of <value> per priest level of happening when a priest is present and preaching the teachings of his god.

req_pregame.text: The event can happen before the first turn, right after the game has been created, but it will never occur otherwise. The message from this events will show up on the first turn of the game. There are no events like this in the standard game (unless you count the two introduction messages), but it can be used to create special start conditions for mods. These events must have an 'always' rarity as no normal events will occur before the first turn.

req_pretawake.text: 1 = Requires the event owner's Pretender God to be alive and on the map somewhere. If the event owner is a disiple player, the team's pretender will be used instead.

req_pretismnr.text: Requires the event owner's Pretender God to be a specific monster type. If the event owner is a disiple player, the team's pretender will be used instead. This command can be used multiple times, in which case only one of the monster types is required.

req_rare.text: The event is extra rare and only has a <percent> chance of being valid when rolled. An always event can be combined with #req_rare to set its chance of happening (per province).

req_realmnr.text: Same as req_mnr, but no shape changing abilities are taken into account. So a werwolf in its human form will not match with the same werewolf's wolf form using this command.

req_researcher.text: There must be a researcher present in the province for the event to happen.

req_school.text: Sets the active research school, this will be useful for later commands.

req_season.text: Event requires this season to happen. 0 = spring 1 = summer 2 = fall 3 = winter Season numbers

req_site.text: Event requires "sitename" to be in the province. It can be discovered or hidden.

req_story.text: Event only happens when story events are enabled. 1 = yes, 0 = no.

req_swamp.text: Event requires the province to have swamp. 1 = must be swamp, 0 = cannot be swamp.

req_targaff.text: Target must have this affliction. If you have multiple afflictions added together, then the target must have all of these afflictions.

req_targally.text: Target must be owned by this nation or one of its allies

req_targforeignok.text: Indicates that the target can be owned by someone else than the owner of the land. The default (without this command) is that all req_targ... commands only target commanders that are owned by the player that owns the land where the event occurs.

req_targgod.text: Target must be god. 1 = must be pretender or disciple, 2 = must be pretender, 0 = cannot be pretender or disciple.

req_targhorrormark.text: Target must have a horror mark of at least this value.

req_targhumanoid.text: Sets item slot requirement for target. 1 = must have hands, 0 = must not have hands.

req_targinanimate.text: Target must (not) be an inanimate being.

req_targinsane.text: Target must (not) be insane and uncontrollable right now.

req_targitem.text: Target must have this magic item.

req_targmagicbeing.text: Target must (not) be a magic being.

req_targmale.text: Sets target's gender requirement. 1 = must be male, 0 = must be female.

req_targmanygems.text: Target must carry many gems (>d20) of this type. Use path number 53 for all type of gems and 56 for all but blood.

req_targmaxkills.text: Target must have killed at most this many people.

req_targmaxmorale.text: Target cannot have higher morale than this

req_targmaxsize.text: Target must be this size of smaller.

req_targminkills.text: Target must have killed at least this many people.

req_targminmorale.text: Target cannot have lower morale than this

req_targminsize.text: Target must be this size or larger.

req_targmnr.text: Target commander must be this monster type. For shape changers the requirement will be ok if any one of its forms matches. This command can be used multiple times.

req_targnoaff.text: Target mustn't have this affliction. If you have multiple afflictions added together, then the target mustn't have all of these afflictions.

req_targnoitem.text: Target must not have this magic item.

req_targnomnr.text: Target commander mustn't be this monster type. For shape changers the requirement will be ok if any one of its forms matches. This command can be used multiple times.

req_targnoorder.text: Target must not be performing this order.

req_targnopath1.text: Must have level 0 in target magic path.

req_targnopath2.text: Must have level 0-1 in target magic path.

req_targnopath3.text: Must have level 0-2 in target magic path.

req_targnopath4.text: Must have level 0-3 in target magic path.

req_targnorealmnr.text: Target commander mustn't be this monster type. This command takes no special care about units with multiple shapes, only the currently active one is taken into account. This command can be used multiple times.

req_targnotally.text: Target must not be owned by this nation or any of its allies

req_targnotowner.text: Target must not be owned by this nation.

req_targorder.text: Target must be performing these orders. This command can be used multiple times, in which case one of the conditions being present is sufficient to fulfill the requirement. Target orders are listed in the table below.

req_targowner.text: Target must owned by this nation. Negative nation number cannot be used and the command can only be used once per event.

req_targpath1.text: Must have level 1+ in target magic path.

req_targpath2.text: Must have level 2+ in target magic path.

req_targpath3.text: Must have level 3+ in target magic path.

req_targpath4.text: Must have level 4+ in target magic path.

req_targprophet.text: Target must be a prophet. 1 = must be a prophet, 0 = cannot be a prophet.

req_targrealmnr.text: Target commander must be this monster type. This command takes no special care about units with multiple shapes, only the currently active one is taken into account. This command can be used multiple times.

req_targseductions.text: Target must have succeded with at least this many seductions (dream seduction and corruption also counts).

req_targsight.text: Target must have eyes and be able to see with them. 1 = must have sight, 0 = cannot have sight.

req_temple.text: There must be a temple in the province. 1 = yes, 0 = no

req_thronesite.text: Event requires a throne (any type) to be in the province.

req_turn.text: The event cannot happen before this turn.

req_turnrare.text: The event is extra rare, but will be increasingly likely with time. It has a <percent + current turn nbr> chance of being valid when rolled. A negative value will create an event that has zero percent of happening until value turns has passed.

req_unclaimedthrone.text: The throne "sitename" must be present in the game and unclaimed. Combine with #req_site to target the throne province.

req_unique.text: The event can only happen <value> times during the course of the game.

req_varneg.text: The event variable must have a value of -1 or lower.

req_varone.text: The event variable must have a value of exactly one.

req_varpos.text: The event variable must have a value of 1 or higher.

req_varzero.text: The event variable must have a value of exactly zero.

req_void.text: Event can only take effect on the void plane (0 = cannot).

req_voidok.text: 1 = The event can also occur on the void/nexus plane. By default events will never occur there.

req_waste.text: Event requires the province to have waste terrain. 1 = must be waste, 0 = cannot be waste.

req_worlditem.text: This item must exist somewhere in the world.

resetcode.text: Removes this event code from the entire world.

resetcodedelay.text: Removes this event code from the entire world, but not immediately. It will be removed after all events have been executed this turn.

resetcodedelay2.text: Removes this event code from the entire world, but not immediately. It will be removed after all events have been executed on the next turn.

resolvearena1.text: The area battles will be resolved and the winner rewarded. This event (or #resolvearena2) must occur the turn after the #arena event occurred.

resolvearena2.text: Same as #resolvearena1, but it will be an arena where the use of magic is prohibited.

revealprov.text: The name of the province is revealed to the entire world.

revealsite.text: Reveals the site called "sitename" in the province. "sitename" must be added to the event message text in brackets.

selectevent.text: This command selects an already existing event. All subsequent commands will modify this event until modding the event is finished with the #end command. Usually you only use the #newevent command and never this one, but it can be useful if you want to modify or disable a single event from the game. This command cannot be used to create new events.

setpoptype.text: Sets the poptype in a province. The poptype will affect what kind of units that can be recruited in the province.

setxp.text: One commander determined by target requirements will get its XP set to this amount. The exact amount of XP is +/-25%.

stealthcom.text: The nations that owns the event gains a sneaking commander of the specified type in the province.

strikeunits.text: All units in the province are hit with an attack.

taxboost.text: Tax income increase in the province for one turn. Use negative numbers for a tax decrease. A value of -100 means no gold income for that turn.

temple.text: The event either creates or destroys a temple. 1 = temple gained, 0 = temple destroyed.

tempunits.text: Units gained after this command are only temporary and disappear afterthe event has taken place, like the longdead horsemen from the Ghost Riders spell. 1 = temporary units, 0 = permanent units.

togglevar.text: Toggles the value of an event var (result = 1-event var). Use to toggle between 1 and 0.

transform.text: One commander determined by target requirements is transformed into another monster, negative numbers can be used for montags.

unrest.text: Unrest in province increased by <value>. Can be negative to reduce unrest.

var0units.text: The nation that owns the event gains a number of units equal to the value of event var 0.

visitors.text: The province is attacked by Bogus the Troll and his Companions.

waterboost.text: One commander determined by target requirements or the monster number may gain +1 Water magic.

worldage.text: Everyone in the world ages this many years. Negative numbers reduceage.

worldcurse.text: Every unit in the world has a <percent> chance of being cursed.

worlddarkness.text: The entire world is covered in darkness for this turn.

worlddecscale.text: Decreases the specified scale in every province in the world by one step.

worlddecscale2.text: Decreases the specified scale in every province in the world by two steps.

worlddecscale3.text: Decreases the specified scale in every province in the world by three steps.

worlddisease.text: Every unit in the world has a <percent> chance of becoming diseased.

worldheal.text: Each unit in the world has a <percent> chance of having one affliction healed.

worldincdom.text: Increases dominion in every province in the world by <value> candles.

worldincscale.text: Increases the specified scale in every province in the world by one step.

worldincscale2.text: Increases the specified scale in every province in the world by two steps.

worldincscale3.text: Increases the specified scale in every province in the world by three steps.

worldmark.text: Every unit in the world has a <percent> chance of being horrormarked.

worldritrebate.text: The casting cost of rituals of this school is reduced by 20% for this turn. School numbers are listed in the table below. Worldritrebate can only be used on normal global events (rarity 11 and 12).

worldunrest.text: Unrest in every province in the world is increased by <value>. Can be negative to reduce unrest.

xp.text: One commander determined by target requirements will receive additional XP. The exact amount of XP gained is +/-25%.

arenagems.text: About this many fire gems will be awarded as the prize for winning the arena. Default is 25.

arenagold.text: About this much gold will be awarded as the prize for winning the arena. Default is 500.

coldincome.text: The effect cold and heat have on income. Default is 5.

coldsupply.text: The effect cold and heat has on supplies. Default is 10.

deathdeath.text: The effect death and growth has on population death in 0.01% per month. Default is 20.

deathincome.text: The effect death and growth has on income. Default is 2.

deathsupply.text: The effect death and growth has on supplies. Default is 10.

eventisrare.text: Random events are divided into two categories, common and rare. This value is the chance of a random event to be a rare one. Default is 15.

gemlongevity.text: This command can be used to make magic gems last for multiple battle within one month. Level 0=normal, 1=gems last entire magic or move phase, 2=gems last entire month.

luckevents.text: How luck affects event frequency. Default is 5.

misfortune.text: How (mis)fortune affects the possibility of an event being good. Default is 15.

poppergold.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

researchscale.text: The amount of research bonus received per mage from a magic scale of +3. Default is 3.

resourcemult.text: A multiplier for the amount of resource found in a land. Default is 100.

slothincome.text: The effect sloth and productivity has on income. Default is 3.

slothresources.text: The effect sloth and productivity have on resources. Default is 15.

startresearch.text: The amount of start research per magic scale above -3. Default is 50 research points.

supplymult.text: A multiplier for the amount of supplies found in a land. Default is 100.

tempscalecap.text: Changing any scale more than this does not yield extra design points. Default value is 3.

turmoilevents.text: How turmoil affects the event frequency. Default is 2.

turmoilincome.text: The effect turmoil and order has on income. Default is 3.

unresthalfinc.text: The amount of unrest that cuts income in half. Default is 50.

unresthalfres.text: The amount of unrest that cuts resources in half. Default is 100.

acidres.text: The item grants an Acid Resistance bonus.

airelementals.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

armor.text: Defines what kind of armor, if any, the units gets when it uses the item. Use #armor 0 to clear an existing armor from a copied item.

att.text: The item grants an attack bonus.

autobless.text: This bearer of this item will be blessed automatically if it is sacred. Like the Flask of Holy Water magic item.

autocompete.text: The bearer of this item will automatically compete in the Arena deathmatch.

autospell.text: Makes the item cast this spell automatically in battle. It will only be cast once unless #autospellrepeat is also used.

autospellrepeat.text: Makes an item cast its autospell every round of combat.

barkskin.text: The item automatically applies the Barkskin spell to the bearer, like the Barkskin Amulet.

batstartsum1.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

batstartsum1d6.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

batstartsum2.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

batstartsum2d6.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

batstartsum3.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

batstartsum3d6.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

batstartsum4.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

batstartsum4d6.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

batstartsum5.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

batstartsum5d6.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

battlesum1.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

battlesum1d2.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

battlesum1d3.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

battlesum2.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

battlesum3.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

battlesum4.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

battlesum5.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

battlesumwarm.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

bers.text: The bearer of the item will go berserk as soon as battle begins. Berserker Pelt has this attribute.

bestowtomount.text: The effects after this command will be bestowed to the mount as well, if any. This doesn't work with all effects that are possible to put on a magic item, but with most.

bless.text: The item automatically applies the Bless spell to the bearer, like the Shroud of the Battle Saint.

champprize.text: This item is given as a reward for winning the championship of the Arena deathmatch.

chestwound.text: The item bearer suffers a Chest Wound affliction, which cannot be healed until the item is removed.

clear.text: Removes all abilities and stats from the magic item.

clearallitems.text: All forgeable magic items are removed from the game.

coldres.text: The item grants a Cold Resistance bonus.

constlevel.text: Level of construction required to forge this item. This level can be 1,3,5,7,9 or 11,13,15 for items that cannot be forged. 11 = unforgable item, 13 = unforgable unique artifact, 15 = unforgable unique per nation artifact.

copyitem.text: Copies all stats from an existing item to the current item.

copyspr.text: Copies the sprite of the specified magic item to the current magic item.

corpselord.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

crippled.text: The item bearer becomes Crippled. The affliction cannot be healed until the item is removed.

cursed.text: The item is cursed and cannot be dropped.

dancenof.text: The number of sprites circling the unit.

dancenratt.text: The number of attacks made per combat round. Minimum is 2.

dancesize.text: The size in percent of normal size, default is 100.

dancespr.text: The look of the sprite circling the unit.

danceweapon.text: The weapon used for the attack.

def.text: The item grants a defense bonus.

descr.text: A text description of the magic item.

domsummon.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

domsummon2.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

domsummon20.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

dragonlord.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

earthelementals.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

enchantedblood.text: Gets points bonus to MR and heals about 0.5 HP per combat round. Also stops bleeding quickly.

end.text: Always use this command at the end of modifying a magic item.

extralife.text: The bearer of the item is resurrected once when killed in combat. The item disappears when the bearer is resurrected.

feeblemind.text: The item bearer becomes Feebleminded. The affliction cannot be healed until the item is removed.

fireelementals.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

fireres.text: The item grants a Fire Resistance bonus.

float.text: The item grants its bearer the ability to float.

fly.text: The item grants its bearer the ability to fly.

guardspiritbonus.text: Increases the chance of receiving a guardian spirit with +value percent.

heavyitem.text: A heavy item cannot be transported with the help of certain magic rituals.

hp.text: The item grants a bonus to hit points.

ironskin.text: The item automatically applies the Ironskin spell to the bearer.

islance.text: This item can only be used by mounted or flying units or centaurs.

itemcost1.text: This command makes the item bonus percent more expensive to forge. Negative values can also be used to make it cheaper. The itemcost1 command only affects the cost of the first magic path.

itemcost2.text: This command makes the item bonus percent more expensive to forge. Negative values can also be used to make it cheaper. The itemcost2 command only affects the cost of the second magic path.

itemdrawsize.text: The value indicates how many percent larger size the item sprite should be drawn at. A negative value means it will be draw at a smaller size than normal.

ivylord.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

lamialord.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

limitedregen.text: Like regeneration, but doesn't work on inanimate beings.

loseeye.text: The item bearer loses an eye. The affliction cannot be healed until the item is removed.

luck.text: The item grants Luck to its bearer, like Faithful.

magicboost.text: The item increases the bearer's magic skill. Path is 0-8 or 51=elements, 52=sorcery, 53=all.

mainlevel.text: Main path level requirement to forge this magic item. The level can be anything from 1 to 8. The cost of forging the magic item also depends on the level requirements.

mainpath.text: Main path required to forge this magic item. The path is a number from 0 to 7 (see table "Magic path numbers").

makemonsters1.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

makemonsters2.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

makemonsters3.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

makemonsters4.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

makemonsters5.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

mapspeed.text: Increase the map movement value for the item's bearer.

maxsize.text: This item can only by a unit of this size or smaller.

minsize.text: This item can only by a unit of this size or larger.

morale.text: The item grants a morale bonus.

mr.text: The item grants a magic resistance bonus.

mute.text: The item bearer becomes Mute. The affliction cannot be healed until the item is removed.

name.text: Sets the name for the active magic item. Changing name of a magic item will remove its description as well, so make sure to set item name before its description.

nationrebate.text: The item is 20% cheaper to forge for this nation. Can be used multiple times on one item to enable it for a few nations. A nation nbr of -1 uses the last manipulated nation, so this command can be used with #newnation.

newitem.text: Creates a new magic item and selects it for modding by the following commands. End modding the magic item with the #end command.

nhwound.text: The item bearer suffers a Never Healing Wound, which cannot be healed until the item is removed.

noaging.text: The wielder of this item has a chance of not aging each year.

noagingland.text: Friendly units in the same province as this item have a chance of not aging each year.

nocoldblood.text: The item cannot be used by coldblooded beings.

nodemon.text: The item cannot be used by demons.

nofemale.text: The item cannot be used by females.

nofind.text: The item cannot be found after battle.

noforgebonus.text: Dwarven hammers and similar will not grant any rebate when used to create this item.

noimmobile.text: The item cannot be used by immobile beings.

noinanim.text: The item cannot be used by inanimate beings.

nomounted.text: The item cannot be used by mounted beings.

notfornation.text: Restricts an item so that it cannot be used by this nation. This command can be used multiple times on the same item.

noundead.text: The item cannot be used by undead.

onisummon.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

onlycoldblood.text: The item can only be used by coldblooded beings.

onlydemon.text: The item can only be used by demons.

onlyfemale.text: The item can only be used by females.

onlyimmobile.text: The item can only be used by immobile beings.

onlyinanim.text: The item can only be used by inanimate beings.

onlymounted.text: The item can only be used by mounted beings.

onlyundead.text: The item can only be used by undead.

pen.text: The item grants a penetration bonus that makes spells cast by the bearer harder to resist.

poisonres.text: The item grants a Poison Resistance bonus.

polyimmune.text: This monster cannot be polymorphed in combat or by the use of transformation rituals.

prec.text: The item grants a precision bonus.

quickness.text: The item grants Quickness (double movement, +2 attack & defense, attacks twice as often).

randomspell.text: The monster has a <percent> chance of casting a random spell in combat instead of a good one.

raredomsummon.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

reanimpriest.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

recuperation.text: The item grants the recuperation ability.

reqeyes.text: The item can only be used by a being with eyes.

restricted.text: The item is restricted to this nation only. Can be used multiple times on one item to enable it for a few nations. A nation nbr of -1 restricts the item to the last manipulated nation, so this command can be used with #newnation.

restricteditem.text: This item can only be used by monsters with the proper #userestricteditem ability value.

run.text: The bearer of the item is able to move further on the battlefield (double combat speed).

secondarylevel.text: Secondary path level requirement to forge this magic item. Works like #mainlevel.

secondarypath.text: Secondary path required to forge this magic item. The path is a number from -1 to 7 from Table 20.

selectitem.text: Selects the magic item that will be affected by the following modding commands. End modding this item with the #end command. In the game you can press ctrl+i when viewing a magic item to see what number it has.

shockres.text: The item grants a Shock Resistance bonus.

sneakunit.text: The item will grant stealth to non-stealthy units.

spell.text: Enables user of item to cast this spell in battle or as a ritual

spr.text: Uses a user made image for item sprite. The image should be 32x32 or 64x64 with the item centered in the picture. The item itself should not be larger than 40x40 pixels. Black will be transparent unless the image is saved with alpha information, in which case that will be used instead.

stealthboost.text: The item will grant a stealth bonus to already stealthy units.

stoneskin.text: The item automatically applies the Stoneskin spell to the bearer, like the Boots of Stone.

stormimmune.text: The bearer of the can fly during a storm.

str.text: The item grants a strength bonus.

summon1.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

summon2.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

summon3.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

summon4.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

summon5.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

swift.text: Grants extra combat speed to the wielder.

tainted.text: Percent chance of being horror marked each turn.

templetrainer.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

type.text: Defines whether the item is 1-handed or 2- handed weapon, a shield, a helmet, a body armor, a pair of boots or something else. See table "Item types".

unique.text: The item can only be forged once, making the item behave like an artifact without being construction level 8.

voidsanity.text: The item grants a voidsanity bonus.

waterbreathing.text: The item grants water breathing to its bearer.

waterelementals.text: The amount of people required for one gold in taxes. Default is 100.

weapon.text: Defines what kind of a weapon, if any, the unit gets when it uses the item. Works on misc item, boots, shield, 2-h weapon, 1-h weapon. Does not work for helmets or armor. Use #weapon 0 to clear an existing weapon from a copied item.

yearaging.text: The wielder of this item will age this many extra years each year.

com.text: What type of monster the commander is.

end.text: This command must be used to end modding a mercenary band,

eramask.text: The era mask determines which eras the band can appear in. See table "Era masks". The default value is All eras.

item.text: A specific magic item for the commander. A maximum four items per band can be assigned.

level.text: Level 0 bands appear early in the game. Level 1 bands appear later and level 2 last of all.

minmen.text: Once the number of troops fall below this, recruitment of new troops will start.

minpay.text: The minimum amount of gold the band can be hired for.

newmerc.text: Creates a new mercenary band. Always end modifying it with an #end command.

nrunits.text: Number of troops in the band.

randequip.text: How powerful magic equipment the commander will have. 0=none, 3=extremely powerful stuff.

recrate.text: The rate at which new troops are bought. A value of 100 means one per month.

unit.text: What type of monster the mercenaries are.

xp.text: Starting experience for the troops. The commander has twice this amount.

description.text: A description of what the mod does, who has created it and so forth.

icon.text: A banner image for your mod. This image should be a 128x32 or 256x64 pixels large TGA image. #version x.yy The version number of your mod. E.g. 1.00 or 1.10. #domversion x.yy The minimum required version of Dominions for the mod to work correctly. If not sure, then leave this command out. For example, 6.00, for Dominions version 6.00 required.

modname.text: A short name for the mod. It will be displayed in the mod preferences screen.

3castbattlespell.text: Works just like the previous ability, except that at least three monsters of this type must be present on the battlefield for the spell to be cast.

aciddigest.text: The monster digests any swallowed creatures and causes their armor to be weakened, like the Rust Mist spell.

acidres.text: Grants acid resistance to the monster.

acidshield.text: Anyone striking this monster will take <damage> points of armor piercing acid damage. The damaged unit will also suffer the effect of weakened armor, as if from the Rust Mist spell. Standard damage for acid shields is 8.

addrandomage.text: Makes the monster start 1 to years (a random die) older.

addupkeep.text: Upkeep will be calculated as if the unit cost this much more to recruit.

adeptsacr.text: Adept Sacrificer. This unit is better at performing blood sacrifices in order to spread the dominion. The value equals number of extra blood magic level for this purpose.

ainorec.text: Will tell the AI to never recruit this monster.

airelementals.text: Gives a size bonus to summoned air elementals.

airrange.text: Air magic cast by the monster have increased range.

airshield.text: The monster gains the airshield special ability.

aisinglerec.text: Will tell the AI to only recruit a single one of these per batch.

alchemy.text: The monster is more efficient when casting spells the converts gems into gold. A typical Alchemist has a value of 50.

allrange.text: All magic cast by the monster have an increased range.

allret.text: Extra chance of returning from any of the other planes a monster can be banished to.

almostliving.text: Unit will require not undead leadership to lead, even though it is undead. This command must come after the #undead command.

almostundead.text: Unit will require undead leadership to lead, even though it isn't an undead or a demon.

ambidextrous.text: This monster gets reduced attack penalty when using two weapons. A normal value is 2 or 3.

amphibian.text: This monster can travel both under and over water.

animal.text: Indicates that the monster is an animal. Animals are affected by the Animal Awe power. Animals receive a morale bonus when led to combat by a beast master.

animalawe.text: Bonus can be a value of one or more. A bonus of one means that animals with a morale of 11 have about 50% chance of daring to strike. A bonus of 10 means that you need a morale of 20 to get a 50% chance. Standard value is 1 (for Awe(+1) ).

animated.text: The monster becomes this if affected by the animate tree spell. This command should only be used on the background trees and bushes that can be found on the battlefield.

ap.text: The number of action points when the monster is unencumbered. This should be about 12 for a human, 20 for a knight or 25 for light cavalry. Action points is the same as combat speed.

appetite.text: A monster with this ability will eat supplies as if he was this many points larger than he actually is and get the Gluttony icon. A negative value can also be used to eat less, but it will not result in any ability icon.

aquatic.text: This monster can only live under water.

armor.text: Equips the monster with this armor. A monster can have up to three armors. One helm, one body armor and one shield. Some common armors can be seen in the Armor Tables section. When modding an existing monster that already has armor, each new #armor command will add a new armor to the monster (up to the limit of three). If you want to change the monster’s armor without adding new ones, you must use the #cleararmor command to remove the existing armor first.

assencloc.text: Specifies an encounter location that the assassinations will appear in. If not specified, a suitable one for each occasion will be used. Possible values can be seen below. Encounter locations 0 random suitable 1 tavern 2 courtyard 3 outside 4 bedroom 5 library 6 commoner house 7 summoning circle (assassin inside circle) 8 summoning circle (assassin at entrance) 7 exploring old ruins

astralrange.text: Astral magic cast by the monster have increased range.

att.text: The basic attack skill of the monster. A normal human soldier has 10 and only the elite of the elite may have 15. The most skilled human unit in the game is the Emerald Lord with attack 15 and defense 14. A dragon has attack 15 and defense 12.

autoberserk.text: 1 = will start the combat by going berserk.

autocompete.text: This monster will automatically compete in the Arena deathmatch.

autocorpsehealer.text: Gives the Corpse Stitcher ability. The monster automatically heals <value> afflictions from corporeal undead units in the same province.

autodisgrinder.text: The monster automatically heals disease from <value> units in the same province. Each disease healed is converted to a Death gem.

autodishealer.text: The monster automatically heals disease from <value> units in the same province. The default value is 1. Only very powerful disease healers should have higher values.

autohealer.text: The monster automatically heals <value> afflictions from units in the same province. The default value is 1. Only very powerful healers should have higher values. The Chalice artifact has a value of 5.

autumnshape.text: Changes into another monster when this season is active.

awe.text: Bonus can be a value of one or more. A bonus of one means that people with a morale of 11 have about 50% chance of daring to strike. A bonus of 10 means that you need a morale of 20 to get a 50% chance. Standard value is 1 (for Awe(+1) ). 24

banefireshield.text: Anyone striking this monster will take <damage> points of armor piercing bane fire damage. The damaged unit will also suffer the effect of the Decay spell if it fails an MR check. Standard damage for bane fire shields is 8.

batstartsum1.text: Summons x monsters at start of battle. The same command can be used up to 3 times on one monster.

batstartsum1d3.text: Summons 1d3 monsters at start of battle. The same command can be used up to 3 times on one monster.

batstartsum1d6.text: Summons xd6 monsters at start of battle. The same command can be used up to 3 times on one monster. All of the monster summoning commands accept negative number values to provide a random summon of a specific type. See table "Negative Monster Numbers" for the list of randomly summonable creatures types. Entries marked with an asterisk may be made worse if the Astral Corruption global enchantment is active or if the cataclysm has occurred.

battleshape.text: The monster changes to this shape when in battle.

battlesum1.text: Automatically summons 0-x monsters to the battlefield each combat round. The #battlesum5 command summons 0-5 and #battlesum1 summons 0-1 monsters etc.

battlesum1d2.text: Automatically summons 1-2 monsters to the battlefield each combat round.

battlesum1d3.text: Automatically summons 1-3 monsters to the battlefield each combat round.

battlesumwarm.text: Automatically summons 1-4(-cold scale) monsters to the battlefield each combat round. Heat scales will not increase the number above 1-4.

beartattoo.text: Magic tattoo like the units of Marverni and Sauromatia have.

beastmaster.text: All animals under the command of this monster have their morale increased by <bonus>.

beckon.text: Gives the monster the ability to lure enemy commanders like the Siren. The value indicates the difficulty of the morale check, 10 is standard.

berserk.text: This monster can go berserk like a barbarian chief or a minotaur. The bonus value will be added to strength and attack and subtracted from defense. It also increases encumbrance. A normal bonus value is 3.

bird.text: Use this for birds, rocs, couatl and similar things.

blessbers.text: Will make unit go berserk when blessed.

blessfly.text: Will grant the unit flying when blessed.

blind.text: This monster has no eyes and cannot be affected by blindness.

bloodrange.text: Blood magic cast by the monster have increased range.

bloodvengeance.text: The monster has the Blood Vengeance ability. Any creature that hits the monster must make a magic resistance check or suffer the same damage that it inflicts on its target. Strength works identically to #damagerev.

bluntres.text: The monster takes half damage from blunt weapons.

boartattoo.text: Magic tattoo like the units of Marverni and Sauromatia have.

bodyguard.text: The monster's morale is increased by <bonus> when its orders are set to Guard Commander. The bodyguard bonus reduces an assassin's Patience value when determining whether the bodyguard is present during an assassination.

bonusspells.text: The monster gets the Innate Spellcaster ability and can cast a number of spells every combat round in addition to its normal attacks. The spellcasting cannot be interrupted or prevented by adjacent enemy units, unlike normal spellcasting. A maximum value of 4 can be used, but no unit in the standard game has more than 3.

bravemount.text: The chance of the mount remaining on the battlefield and continuing to fight. Default is 0.

bringeroffortune.text: Selects the nametype that will be affected by the following modding commands. Nametype nbr is a number between 100 and 399. See Table Name Types below. Numbers 170 – 399 can be used to make your own name tables without altering existing ones.

bug.text: Monsters with this tag are summoned by the Swarm spell on land.

bugreform.text: This is a combat ability. When killed the monster will turn into a myriad of bugs and reform a little while later. The worm mage has this ability. The type of bugs created can be controlled by the following 4 commands.

bugshape.text: This is the shape for the "soul bug". It's the one that will later be reformed into the mage if it survives long enough. By default it is a bug soul vessel (a beetle with immortality).

bugswarmshape.text: This is the shape of the random bugs that will make up that main part of the swarm. By default this is a random bug (monster nbr = -9).

bugswarmuwshape.text: This is the shape of the random bugs if they are underwater.

buguwshape.text: This is the shape for the "soul bug" if it is underwater.

carcasscollector.text: The monster can turn <value> nature gems to <value> death gems per turn.

castledef.text: Gives a castle defense bonus to the monster. The monster counts as <value> extra monsters when defending a fort from a siege.

chaospower.text: The monster will get stat increases or decreases depending on the Turmoil scale.

chaosrec.text: The monster is cheaper to recruit if there are Turmoil scales in the province. The monster costs (<value> x <Turmoil level>) less gold to recruit. Order scales do not affect the price. The recruiting player pays full price for the unit on purchase, but gets the turmoil discount back into the treasury when the monster joins the army.

chorusmaster.text: The monster is automatically a chorus master and does not need to cast the Communion Master spell to join a chorus.

chorusslave.text: The monster is automatically a chorus slave and does not need to cast the Communion Slave spell to join a chorus.

cleanshape.text: The monster will heal all afflictions and hp if changing shape from secondshape to firstshape. This command must be applied to the monster's firstshape, so for a werewolf the human form.

clear.text: Removes all weapons, armors, stats, magic skills and special abilities from the monster. A useful command when modifying an existing monster.

cleararmor.text: Removes all armor from the active monster. Must be used before assigning new armor or armor assignment does not work correctly.

clearmagic.text: Removes all magic skills from the active monster.

clearspec.text: Removes all special abilities from the active monster. The special abilities are stuff like Holy, Fire Resistance, Awe, etc.

clearweapons.text: Removes all weapons from the active monster. Must be used before assigning new weapons or the monster will have both old and new weapons.

clumsy.text: This monster will only receive half att/def bonuses from weapons.

cold.text: This monster is surrounded by cold like a Winter Wolf. The chill aura is <value> + Water magic squares in size. Standard value is 3.

coldblood.text: Cold blooded like the lizards of C’tis.

coldpower.text: The monster will get stat increases or decreases depending on the Cold scale.

coldrecscale.text: Cold scale requirement for recruitment. (The old #coldrec command also works, but is deprecated).

coldres.text: Grants cold resistance to the monster. A value of 5 or more protects the monster from the fatigue effects of a chill aura.

combatcaster.text: Selects the nametype that will be affected by the following modding commands. Nametype nbr is a number between 100 and 399. See Table Name Types below. Numbers 170 – 399 can be used to make your own name tables without altering existing ones.

command.text: Increases leadership value by this amount.

commaster.text: The monster is automatically a communion master and does not need to cast the Communion Master spell to join a communion, like the Trophimos Oppressors.

comslave.text: The monster is automatically a sabbath master and does not need to cast the Communion Master spell to join a sabbath.

copyspr.text: Copies the sprite from an existing monster to the current one. Do not use this if you intend to change the sprite using the #spr1 command as it would then change the looks of both monsters.

copystats.text: Copies all weapons, armors, stats, magic skills and special abilities from an existing monster. The existing monster can be a monster that has been created previously in the mod. Copystats will overwrite all previous commands for the selected monster, so it should be used as the first command after the #newmonster command.

coridermnr.text: Use this to set the type of co-riders if any. Unless there are more than one rider on the same mount there is no need for this command.

corpseeater.text: The monster will eat this amount of corpses per month if possible and gain HP for it equal to the value in #deadhp.

corpselord.text: This monster will receive extra units when creating Corpse Men. This ability will not be visible when inspecting the monster.

corruptor.text: Gives the monster the corruption ability like a Shaytan. The value indicates the difficulty of the morale check, 10 is standard.

crossbreeder.text: The monster is skilled in crossbreeding and gets a bonus when using the Crossbreeding or Improved Crossbreeding ritual from the Blood magic school. The crossbreeder receives more units per casting and a higher chance of extraordinary results.
